Sheet.dc.html.title: 4 · The sheet for the oncologist, printed

decisions.text:
Design decisions

• Findings are words in ink. "May not fit", "Few of this trial's rules could be checked" and a trial for other cancers each get a labelled block in the same neutral style as every other section. They're told apart by their label and by coming first, never by colour or weight.
• The trial's words: a quoted block in Plex with a small mono label. The person's words: the --you fill, in Atkinson. The page's words: plain ink.
• A trial's number is its place in the order, set small in mono, not as a big badge.
• "I don't know" is the same button as Yes and No, same size, same style.
• The short list: a rail on the right holds the picked trials and Check these. On a phone it becomes a bar at the bottom.
• The record: Chart v2's summary column, with the finder's five sections and their counts. Findings are right-aligned, 500 weight, the same for every outcome.
• Phone is everything ≤ 600 px, from container queries in chart.css.

New sentences (to go through copy.ts and the verdict scan)
• Start form, "What happens next": "A few questions, one at a time." / "A short list of trials to ask your oncologist about." / "A sheet to print for your visit."
• Check these failed: "The check couldn't start. Nothing on your list changed. Try again."
• Record summary: the label "This record" and one line under each section ("Asked in the questions before the check.", "Answered here, rule by rule.", "Lab values, chart-only rules, and what you didn't know.", "Rules about the trial's own procedures.", "Every \"may not fit\", and every rule that needs your records."), and "6 rules" on the folded lab values.
• Questions header: "Lung cancer (non-small cell) · 97201 · 50 miles" (the search, as data). Phone pick bar: "Your check 2 / 3".

Wording reshaped (same words, new arrangement)
• Sheet: "7 of these 10 trials ask about this." becomes a table with the column "Trials that ask" and "7 of these 10". "Said:" / "Answer:" become column heads.
• Check question: "The trial asks about this: “…”. Does this describe you?" is split into a quoted rule and the question.
• Printed record: "To ask your oncologist" comes first, for the doctor; the column head "Asked earlier, and what you said" is new.

Not real data
• Trial 2's "May not fit" is illustrative: p08's top ten have none, so its rule is made up for the design.
• Rows on the record are excerpts: the counts are the real ones, not every row is drawn.
• Settings' [estimate] and [month] are placeholders.

Contrast: no colour beyond Chart v2's tokens, whose pairs pass AA in both themes; the print boards use the light tokens on white.

fonts.text: On this canvas only, the three families load from Google Fonts so the boards render. The app bundles them as WOFF2 and requests nothing off the machine (intent, Constraints).
